title: The Compass of the Upper Fly River
premise: Ivo Okonkwo, a salvage diver haunted by the wreck his navy employers refuse to name, takes a dying prospector's hand-drawn map in exchange for a promise to find the man's lost daughter. The map points not to treasure but to evidence: a cargo manifest proving the navy scuttled its own ship to bury a smuggling operation. Racing a salvage fleet that will erase the proof within six tides, Ivo assembles an unlikely crew of outcasts who become the family he never had. In the flooded hold of the wreck, Ivo must choose between salvaging gold that would free him forever and raising the manifest that would convict powerful men — and he chooses justice, surfacing with proof, the prospector's daughter at his side, and a found family bound by what they refused to leave behind.
about_author: Ines Lockridge is a former maritime surveyor who spent a decade charting river deltas before turning to fiction full-time. She writes adventure novels about people who measure their lives in water, distance, and debts they can't quite name.

chapters.title: Six Tides
chapters.summary: Ivo Okonkwo's POV. Working a classified wreck for a navy contractor, Ivo counts his life in miles traveled rather than years lived. When command orders him to falsify depth readings, he refuses quietly and is dismissed. Emotional beat: restless discontent, a man adrift in his own routine.

chapters.title: The Dying Man's Bargain
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. A fever-wracked prospector named Eben Marsh collapses at Ivo's dockside shack and trades a grease-stained map for a promise: find my daughter, Ada. He dies by dawn. The map marks coordinates inside the forbidden wreck zone. Emotional beat: grief entangled with obligation.

chapters.title: What the Map Shows
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Studying the map over cheap rum, Ivo realizes it charts not treasure but a sealed compartment on the very wreck he was fired from — one the navy's own surveys never mention. Emotional beat: dawning dread; the promise just became dangerous.

chapters.title: The Cook Who Sank a Ship
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Ivo seeks out Delphine Okafor, a disgraced naval cook turned riverboat chef who once served aboard the sunken vessel and knows its layout by heart. She agrees, demanding truth over gold. Emotional beat: first spark of found family.

chapters.title: Ada Marsh
chapters.summary: Delphine's POV. They trace Ada Marsh to a mission school upriver, where she works as a nurse and wants nothing to do with her father's obsession. She reveals Eben stole the map from a navy clerk — and that men have already come asking for it. Emotional beat: resentment cracking into curiosity.

chapters.title: The Fleet Gathers
chapters.summary: Ada's POV. From the mission's ridge, Ada watches salvage barges massing downriver under civilian flags she recognizes as navy fronts. Six tides until they reach the wreck. Emotional beat: fear hardening into resolve; she joins them.

chapters.title: The Riverboat Magpie
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. To outrun the fleet they need speed, so Ivo gambles everything on buying the Magpie, a rotting riverboat, from Ferro Lantz, a smuggler who accepts payment in secrets. Emotional beat: reckless hope; the crew takes shape.

chapters.title: First Tide
chapters.summary: Delphine's POV. The Magpie runs the river at night while Delphine drills the crew on the wreck's flooded corridors from memory. Ada and Ivo clash over whether her father was a thief or a witness. Emotional beat: friction masking growing trust.

chapters.title: Checkpoint at Kolo Bend
chapters.summary: Ada's POV. A navy patrol stops the boat; Ferro's forged papers nearly fail until Ada talks her way through using her late mother's clan ties. They learn the fleet carries demolition charges, not salvage gear. Emotional beat: terror sharpening purpose — the navy means to destroy evidence.

chapters.title: Second Tide
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Running dark through rapids, the Magpie grounds on a sandbar. While refloating her, Ivo confesses why he measures life in miles: a brother lost at sea whose death the navy also buried. Emotional beat: vulnerability; the crew becomes a confessional.

chapters.title: Ferro's Price
chapters.summary: Delphine's POV. Ferro catches up midriver and demands the map as final payment. Delphine bluffs him with a copy, but suspects he'll sell them out. Emotional beat: betrayal foreshadowed; loyalty tested by arithmetic.

chapters.title: Third Tide
chapters.summary: Ada's POV. A storm forces them into a hidden lagoon where Ada finds her father's old camp — journals proving he witnessed the scuttling and fled with the manifest's location memorized. Emotional beat: reconciliation with the dead; Ada claims the mission as hers.

chapters.title: The Wreck Zone
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. They slip past the zone buoy at slack water and see the fleet anchored ahead, floodlights sweeping. Ivo plans a dive through a collapsed cargo hatch the navy doesn't know exists. Emotional beat: cold clarity before the plunge.

chapters.title: Fourth Tide: Down
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Ivo dives alone into black water, navigating Delphine's remembered corridors, finding the sealed compartment — and human remains wearing a navy uniform, shot before the sinking. Emotional beat: horror confirming the crime; the dead demand witness.

chapters.title: Surface Fire
chapters.summary: Delphine's POV. While Ivo dives, a patrol skiff boards the Magpie. Delphine stalls with charm and lies while Ada hides the dive gear ashore. Ferro, present with the fleet, says nothing — either mercy or strategy. Emotional beat: nerve-fraying suspense.

chapters.title: Fifth Tide: The Manifest
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Ivo recovers the waterproofed manifest and a captain's logbook, but his air line snags and he surfaces half-drowned, delirious, clutching the tube. Ada keeps him breathing through the night. Emotional beat: cost made flesh; devotion unspoken.

chapters.title: Ferro's Choice
chapters.summary: Ferro's POV. Cornered by the fleet commander, who offers him Ivo's head for his old debts, Ferro instead burns his own ledgers and warns the crew — paying his price in ruin. Emotional beat: redemption bought at bankruptcy.

chapters.title: Sixth Tide: The Hold
chapters.summary: Ada's POV. Trapped between the fleet and the falls, the crew takes refuge inside the wreck itself as demolition charges detonate above. In the flooding dark, strangers move as one body, sealing bulkheads, sharing air. Emotional beat: terror transfigured into unity.

chapters.title: What Rises
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Using the scuttling charge's own blast wave, Ivo rides the pressure surge up through the cargo hatch as the stern section breaks apart — surfacing with the manifest intact as the wreck dies around him. Emotional beat: rebirth through catastrophe.

chapters.title: The Tribunal at Port Meridian
chapters.summary: Delphine's POV. The crew delivers the manifest to a maritime tribunal and a muckraking journalist; officers are arrested, the cover-up cracks open publicly. Delphine testifies about the cook's mess the night the ship died. Emotional beat: justice outside the law vindicated inside it.

chapters.title: Miles No More
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Cleared of his dismissal, offered his old commission back, Ivo declines. He buys the Magpie outright, and the crew signs articles as partners, not employees. Emotional beat: identity remade — he counts his life in people now.

chapters.title: The Compass of the Upper Fly River
chapters.summary: Ada's POV. One year later, the Magpie runs charter and rescue work upriver. At Eben's grave, Ada leaves the original map and reads his last letter aloud. Ivo steers toward open water with his family aboard. Emotional beat: peace earned; the compass finally pointing home.
